$comment: OPTIONAL STARTING TEMPLATES — not a taxonomy. Every label here is an example the agent may fork, re-tune from REA evidence, or ignore entirely by authoring a profile with its own playstyle label. No preset is a required choice and no game is expected to match one.

presets.name: Covert Espionage Operative
presets.notes: High precision, prioritizes parries, disarm finishers, and cover-to-cover advances. Ideal for narrative espionage and action thrillers where repetitive firefights break immersion.

presets.name: Mythic Vanguard Mercenary
presets.notes: Designed for open-world action RPGs (e.g., Assassin's Creed Odyssey). Aggressive gap-closing, active parry-counters on enemy wind-up, and dynamic ability rotation.

presets.name: Battlefield Field Commander
presets.notes: Replaces naive 'F5 charge-nearest' bots in sandbox battle simulators with formation-aware positioning, directional blocking, and threat-weighted target selection.

presets.name: Arcane Scholar
presets.notes: Kite-first spellcaster: keeps a wide ring, spends on control and area denial before damage, and treats stamina/mana as the binding constraint rather than health.

presets.name: Ranged Skirmisher
presets.notes: Bow/gun hit-and-run: fires from max effective range, repositions after every volley, and refuses melee unless cornered.
